capabilities: Move tabs to the previous or next tab group (split)
Navigate to the next or previous open tab across tab group boundaries
Bind both actions to custom hotkeys
extras: Warning in README: the plugin reads unofficial internal API properties (leaf and tabs objects) and may break if those change; tab-group detection assumes leaf order matches tab-group order and may misbehave with many splits.
intentEvidence: This is a tab navigating plugin that behaves similarly to those in code editors.
motivation: The author wanted tab handling similar to code editors and found the existing Next Tab command does not cross tab group boundaries.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to move a tab to an adjacent split or to cycle through open tabs across tab group boundaries with keyboard shortcuts.

relations.evidence: It has the same behavior as, e.g., the tab-shifter plugin for WebStorm.

summary: Keyboard-driven tab manager that moves tabs between split groups and navigates to next or previous tabs across split boundaries.
